CCLF set but the message ends two octets into the configuration header
fixtures.varied: message cut inside config header; total size 10

fixtures.summary: Message ends inside the four-octet wave chunk header
fixtures.varied: wave chunk header cut after 2 octets; total size 30

refs: Hello 6.1 p21 (packet size vs message length)

fixtures.summary: Sample array length not a multiple of the 8-octet sample size
refs: Stream 6.1 p38 (octets per sample must match configuration)
fixtures.note: Rejecting the whole chunk (not truncating to 20 samples) is the plan 01 decoder contract.

X=768 Y=-768 R=0xFF G=0x80 B=0x00 I=0xFF

fixtures.summary: Wave chunk with duration 0

refs: Stream 3.4 p15 (at least one draw color is mandatory)

X=768 Y=-768 R=0xFF G=0x80 B=0x00 I=0xFF

refs: Stream 3.4 p15 (SHALL abort on unspecified category/subcategory)

segments.value: X=256 Y=-256 R=0xFF G=0x80 B=0x00 I=0xFF
X=512 Y=-512 R=0xFF G=0x80 B=0x00 I=0xFF
X=768 Y=-768 R=0xFF G=0x80 B=0x00 I=0xFF

fixtures.summary: Hint format 1 (sample-stream shutter) replacing intensity
fixtures.note: Plan 01 shutter gate decides support; until then a precise unsupported result with no output.

segments.value: X=256 Y=-256 R=0xFF G=0x80 B=0x00 I=0xFF
X=512 Y=-512 R=0xFF G=0x80 B=0x00 I=0xFF
X=768 Y=-768 R=0xFF G=0x80 B=0x00 I=0xFF

expect.if_implemented: accept; SHT bit (octet 7 bit 0) controls the shutter

fixtures.summary: Wavelength prefix + color with wavelength 0 in place of blue
fixtures.note: Valid per Stream 3.4.8/3.4.9; support is a plan 01 decision, so the expected result is unsupported with no output until implemented.

segments.value: X=256 Y=-256 R=0xFF G=0x80 B=0x00 I=0xFF
X=512 Y=-512 R=0xFF G=0x80 B=0x00 I=0xFF
X=768 Y=-768 R=0xFF G=0x80 B=0x00 I=0xFF

expect.if_implemented: accept; octet 6 is the wavelength (4 nm steps), octet 7 its intensity

fixtures.summary: Break tag (second scan head) after the first head's descriptors
fixtures.note: Stream 3.4.3 lets single-head decoders abort or ignore tags after Break; this project treats it as unsupported (no output) until plan 01 decides.

segments.value: X=256 Y=-256 R=0xFF G=0x80 B=0x00 I=0xFF
X=512 Y=-512 R=0xFF G=0x80 B=0x00 I=0xFF
X=768 Y=-768 R=0xFF G=0x80 B=0x00 I=0xFF

expect.alternative: Stream 3.4.3 also permits single-head decoders to ignore tags after Break; the project must pick one and document it
